rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template: both Eisenhower letters frame a troubled domestic raw-material industry against broader foreign-trade or international-policy concerns, order a comprehensive executive study to supplement an existing Tariff Commission investigation, and require results before the Commission's report is due. C16 is a strong substantive antecedent and shares language about shortages, national security, economic expansion, comprehensive materials policy, recommendations, and governmental/private cooperation; however, the child expressly identifies that Commission's work as an input, making it more clearly source material than the immediate drafting model. C09 similarly creates an interagency resource-study committee, designates leadership, solicits agency and private participation, draws on prior work, and demands recommendations by a deadline, but its machinery and wording are less specifically aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As we look forward to the resolution of this problem, we now face depressed conditions within numerous metal mining districts... Every effort should be made to preserve this newly added economic strength through policies that would be consistent with our other national and international policies.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a broader study of the domestic factors which have contributed to the decline in sheep numbers and wool production... constructive suggestions which will promote the development of a sound and prosperous domestic wool industry and at the same time permit an expanding foreign trade.
shared_material.explanation: Both letters connect distress in a domestic raw-material industry to the need for a durable policy compatible with wider international or trade policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the United States Tariff Commission was requested... to make an investigation of the lead and zinc industries... It would be extremely helpful if your study could be completed for consideration well before that date.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: this investigation by the Tariff Commission [should] be supplemented by a broader study... I request that the findings be available at least in preliminary draft by the time the Tariff Commission makes its report
shared_material.explanation: This is the strongest parallel: a broader executive study supplements a commodity-specific Tariff Commission investigation and is timed to precede or coincide with its report.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am establishing a Cabinet Committee, whose task will be the preparation of recommendations... work in close cooperation with... departments and agencies... as well as private individuals and organizations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I request that the Department of Agriculture immediately take appropriate steps to implement a comprehensive study... set forth constructive suggestions
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts the earlier study-and-recommendation assignment into a Cabinet committee with broader participation.
